title: campanula morettiana
intro: Campanula morettiana, commonly known as the Moretti's bellflower, is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family. It is native to the Himalayas and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Campanula morettiana include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, antibacterial, and antifungal properties.
